businesses.name: NVIDIA accelerated-computing platform
businesses.economicMeaning: A scaling platform business spanning accelerator silicon, networking and software, with value driven by accelerator demand, networking adoption, software mix and free-cash-flow durability.
businesses.segmentationBasis: Company-level operating model; segment-level disclosure and cost allocation are pending tool retrieval.

revenueDriver.note: Uses the supplied forward revenue baseline as a placeholder pending reported segment and KPI disclosure; not treated as a permanent growth assumption.

costDrivers.note: Forward FCF is supplied as revenue multiplied by a normalized FCF margin; detailed cost-driver disclosure is pending.

forecastAssumptions.rationale: Supplied internal forecast based on historical growth with sector mean reversion.
Supplied internal forecast based on forward revenue and normalized FCF margin.
Supplied book effective tax rate; cash-tax disclosure is unavailable.

growthConstraints.rationale: Bound forecast growth until company-specific management guidance and segment KPIs are retrieved; no unsupported permanent growth uplift is applied.
Terminal growth is capped at the supplied policy assumption.

businesses.rationale: Use normalized DCF as the primary operating-capability method because the supplied evidence includes a complete unlevered FCFF bridge and six cash-flow observations. Current operating value and future ramp potential should remain separate until segment disclosure, guidance and KPI evidence are retrieved.
applicabilityConditions: FCFF bridge remains complete and internally consistent.
WACC and terminal growth remain policy-supported rather than price-derived.
Future capacity, penetration and software-mix upside is not credited without company-specific evidence.
Net cash and dilution are incorporated separately from operating value.
overlaps: Do not combine normalized DCF with the supplied EV/FCF, EV/EBITDA or EV/Sales guardrails without an explicit ensemble rule.
Do not add separate accelerator, networking or software optionality until segment economics and required investment are evidenced.

valuationMethods.rationale: Primary method supported by the supplied FCFF bridge and normalized cash-flow series; no price-based calibration is used.

probabilitiesCheck.note: No optionality scenarios are specified because the supplied evidence does not quantify distinct commercial outcomes, required capital, financing or dilution.

sources.label: Supplied NVIDIA operating baseline and derived forecast inputs

missingEvidence: Reported segment revenue, costs and capex
Explicit capacity-ramp, penetration and software-mix evidence
Capex, working-capital and financing requirements for future operating scenarios
crossChecks: Compare the normalized DCF against the supplied EV/FCF, EV/EBITDA and EV/Sales guardrails only after verifying that their forecast basis and denominator periods match.
Reconcile the six supplied cash-flow observations with the latest filing and reported segment disclosures.
Check that net cash, diluted shares and any stock compensation are not omitted from the equity bridge.
thesisChanges: Maintain a scaling-stage thesis based on the supplied accelerated-computing platform classification, but do not assign additional value to unbuilt future software, networking or capacity economics until disclosed evidence is retrieved.
Treat the supplied forecast as an internal baseline rather than independently verified management guidance.
Keep loss-making or new optional businesses out of the base case unless their mature economics and investment requirements are evidenced.
